comments.author: Jayhawker32
comments.body_html:
Think I answered my own question for those who want to do the same.

1. Open “…\SPT_Data\Server\database\templates\items.json”

2. Search for “6087e570b998180e9f76dc24”

3. Change “Weight” = 1.4 to whatever you want in kg’s

3a. For those who want to go the extra mile, the DB 5000 weighs 5.7 kg’s IRL
